reason: Document A accepts the staff's numbers, gives grounded evidence (two captains say they'd sell, plus the honest line 'it won't be none'), and offers concrete help: trip logs and a test of a catch-reporting app. That gives commissioners who trust their staff a workable path. Document B multiplies one boat's loss across all 11 boats without support and proposes alternatives the captain never authorized, so it reads as the usual charter-hearing appeal.
